description_en: It can accurately detect the bank card number and validity period on various types of bank cards. It supports recognition and extraction from both horizontal and vertical cards, as well as cards tilted at any angle. It covers most banks in the Chinese mainland and supports cards with varying digit lengths, embossed surfaces, flat surfaces, and other formats
description_zh: 可精准识别各类银行卡中的银行卡卡号和有效期，且支持横卡、竖卡及银行卡任意角度偏斜情况的识别与提取，支持中国内地大多数银行，以及各种位数、凸字卡面、平面卡面等的识别
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-bank-card --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1fL.fiCzqK1RjSZPcXXbTepXa-3116-2139.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeBankCard

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one, and neither can be empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one, and neither can be empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
